publication.note: Publication revision must be mapped to the captured runtime by the final PR/tree and file hashes; it is not a newly hardware-tested revision.

localCandidateContentReview.note: Read-only comparison of recorded candidate hashes with the integration checkout; LF/CRLF differences are explicit and do not create a new hardware execution identity.

precommitVerification.note: Build, focused units, lint and probes ran in the candidate working tree before the hardware runtime commit. Preserve their actual source/status and bundle attribution.

productionBehavior.blur: Normalized 5x5 kernel reconstructed by nine bilinear texture samples in the existing single quarter-resolution blur pass

visualReview.scope: Representative original frames, derived crops/contact sheets, and motion aggregate metrics
observations: More compact, smoother inner glow; overall change is subtle.
B1/B2 Rays and Corona structure remains; black space is preserved in the reviewed views.
Inherited cloudlike Corona quality and NaturalEarth seam remain.

selectedPixelMetrics.coordinateSystem: Full-frame sRGB pixels; centered Sun at (960,540)
selectedPixelMetrics.limit: Three centered 60-degree scenes only; no guarantee for other scenes or all exposures. White threshold is all RGB channels >=250.

occlusion.method: Sun.show on/off at fixed state for Bloom 0.35 and 0; compare solar-added signal, not total atmospheric radiance.
occlusion.hdrCoverage: 49 sampled positions in scene-linear HDR and each of Bloom A/B; not full-texture HDR readback.

limitations: Photometry and adjacent-frame differences are whole-frame aggregates, not Sun ROI quality or proof of no local flicker.
